title: Device, provider and network matrix shows where Ritmo plays
acceptance: device-provider-matrix.md has an owner-witnessed Pass for Apple Music and for Spotify on each D25 platform (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Android) on at least one cellular and one Wi-Fi network each where the provider's app works.

Rows record device, browser, network kind, date, Worker or bundle, and the exact observed outcome; UI or SDK success alone never passes.
